mapper.update:
/* SQL ID : AsmtFdbkDAO.asmtFdbkModify 설 명 : 과제 피드백 수정 */
MERGE INTO TB_LMS_ASMT_FDBK FDBK USING ( SELECT #{asmtFdbkId} AS ASMT_FDBK_ID , #{asmtId} AS ASMT_ID , #{userId} AS USER_ID , #{fdbkCts} AS FDBK_CTS , #{rgtrId} AS RGTR_ID , #{mdfrId} AS MDFR_ID FROM DUAL ) USR ON ( FDBK.ASMT_FDBK_ID = USR.ASMT_FDBK_ID AND FDBK.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET FDBK.FDBK_CTS = USR.FDBK_CTS , FDBK.MDFR_ID = USR.MDFR_ID , FDBK.MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ASMT_FDBK_ID , ASMT_ID , USER_ID , FDBK_CTS , DELYN , PUSH_ALIMYN , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM ) VALUES ( USR.ASMT_FDBK_ID , USR.ASMT_ID , USR.USER_ID , USR.FDBK_CTS , 'N' , 'Y' , USR.RGTR_ID , FN_DTTM() )
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : AsmtFdbkDAO.asmtFdbkSelect 설 명 : 과제 피드백 조회 */ SELECT FDBK.* , FN_REF_FILE_CNT(FDBK.ASMT_FDBK_ID) AS FILE_CNT FROM TB_LMS_ASMT_FDBK FDBK WHERE DELYN = 'N' AND FDBK.ASMT_FDBK_ID = #{asmtFdbkId}
